title: Placement — TOEFL Sentence Insertion variant (decoy gaps)

questions.title: Single-item placement with 4 candidate positions
questions.prompt: Where does this sentence best fit? «That step is what links the energy of sunlight to the chemistry of every meal we eat.»
questions.passage: Photosynthesis converts sunlight into sugars. @@@1 The reaction takes place in chloroplasts. @@@2 Light splits water and frees electrons. @@@3 Those electrons drive the assembly of carbon dioxide into glucose. @@@4

placements.item: That step is what links the energy of sunlight to the chemistry of every meal we eat.
